identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Prevent publication metadata tail from blocking exact-clean finish

values.task_boundary: Issue #306 only; publication/finish-tail tooling and focused tests without active-lane mutation.
deliverables: Fail-closed publish ordering or safe metadata classification
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: csdlc-publish either includes required publication metadata in the exact pushed head or records local metadata as explicitly safe, nonblocking, and absent from finish's exact-clean git status surface before publication reports success.

AC-2: No successful publication result can leave an uncommitted required lifecycle/publication tail or git-visible safe-cache tail that finish must consume or reject while the remote head does not contain it.
AC-3: Create, update, and noop publication retries are deterministic and do not duplicate or overwrite publication intent or record truth.
AC-4: csdlc-finish can verify the exact published head without requiring a second publication cycle solely to absorb publish-created metadata.
AC-5: Focused tests cover create, update, noop, interrupted-after-push, interrupted-after-intent, interrupted-after-record, and finish-readiness cases.
AC-6: Existing review-staleness behavior for committed typed metadata remains compatible.
AC-7: Fresh exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.
dependencies: Blocks truthful Sprint 6 terminal finish/closeout for affected open publication tails until fixed or explicitly worked around
non_goals: No implementation in #295, #301, #298, #258, #5913, or other active issue worktrees or root staging packets
No PR publication or merge during planning
No weakening exact-head review, exact-clean finish, or GitHub remote identity checks
